design_note: EDGE.md §42e (declared before any new shadow reading)

human_risk_memo_signed.how_to_satisfy: A human writes and signs a risk memo and records its path here. No process may produce this.

forward_shadow_clean.evidence: 0 of 20 forward closed trades; 0 of 180 days. The corpus ends on the same day the cleared measurement was taken, so ZERO genuinely forward observations exist. artifacts/slice59_forward_shadow.json declares is_forward_observation false and forward_observations_to_date 0.
forward_shadow_clean.how_to_satisfy: Run the pilot forward on data that did not exist when the rule was measured. A replay over the cleared window does NOT count and is the substitution this item exists to prevent.

m4_recent_half_accepted_or_recovered.evidence: M4_halves currently reads WARN — earlier half +0.4669 on 17, recent half -0.0798 on 18. Not accepted in any memo, not recovered.
m4_recent_half_accepted_or_recovered.how_to_satisfy: Either a human explicitly accepts this in the signed memo, or new forward data brings the recent half back above zero UNDER THE UNCHANGED THRESHOLD. Moving the threshold is forbidden and would not satisfy this.

kill_switch_drill_recorded.how_to_satisfy: Trip the switch, confirm entries are blocked, clear it with the exact human token, and record the transcript.

linear_protective_stop_verified.evidence: not documented. NOTE: docs/PAPER_OPERATOR_RUNBOOK.md §H records that the linear SIMULATOR raises NotImplementedError — the live linear path is implemented and unit-tested, but the simulated one models spot cash accounting only. A human must document how a protective stop is verified on linear before any micro-live.
linear_protective_stop_verified.how_to_satisfy: Document and demonstrate the verification path.

notional_cap_within_policy.note: Re-derived from the live tree by the gate, never trusted from this file.

live_trading_ack_present.evidence: LIVE_TRADING_ACK is not satisfied; live_authorized is false
live_trading_ack_present.how_to_satisfy: A human sets the exact token AND turns testnet off AND turns paper off AND supplies both credentials. Missing any one degrades to paper and logs the reason.

models_current_absent_or_contained.note: Re-derived from the live tree by the gate.

note_on_ownership: Six of eight items are things a HUMAN does. A gate a process could satisfy on its own is not a gate. The two machine items are re-derived from the live tree by promotion_gate.evaluate_promotion_gate rather than read from this file, so a hand-edited JSON cannot assert them falsely.
note_on_fail_closed: Flipping every bool in this file to true does NOT allow live: the gate requires the checklist AND config.is_live_authorized independently, and the gate can neither write live_authorized nor clear the kill switch. A missing or unreadable file means REFUSE, not 'assume complete'.
